title: Hearing the Word
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Hearing the Word means receiving God’s truth as it is read, preached, taught, and proclaimed. God uses the heard Word to awaken faith, confront sin, comfort the weak, and call His people to obedience.
summary: Hearing the Word means receiving God’s truth as it is read, preached, taught, and proclaimed. God uses the heard Word to awaken faith, confront sin, comfort the weak, and call His people to obedience.
christFocus: Faith comes through the message of Christ. When the Word is faithfully proclaimed, people are called to hear the good news of Jesus, receive His truth, and follow Him with enduring faith.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God has always gathered His people around His Word. Scripture is to be read, explained, preached, and heard with reverence. Hearing is not passive entertainment; it is a serious encounter with truth from God.

Faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the Word of God. The proclamation of Scripture is one of the ordinary means God uses to bring sinners to Christ and strengthen believers in faith.

Jesus warned that not all hearing is faithful hearing. Some hear with hard hearts, shallow hearts, distracted hearts, or divided hearts. The good soil receives the Word, holds it fast, and bears fruit with patience.

The blessing is not in hearing only, but in receiving and doing what God has spoken. The one who hears and forgets deceives himself, but the one who hears and obeys is shaped by truth.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people hear sermons, lessons, podcasts, or Scripture readings without truly receiving the Word. It is possible to be around Bible teaching often while still resisting correction, repentance, faith, or obedience.

This doctrine calls believers to listen with humility. God may use the preached or taught Word to expose what is hidden, comfort what is wounded, strengthen what is weak, and call His people back to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Prepare your heart to hear God’s Word. Listen with humility, test what is taught by Scripture, receive correction without defensiveness, and respond with faith and obedience. Do not measure hearing by emotion alone; ask whether the Word is leading you to repentance, trust, worship, endurance, and faithfulness to Christ.
